name: Gok
backstory: Works at Hotel Kholi, the main and oldest hotel in Khan Ice — a staple of Khanician architecture and flagship of Milkaan's hospitality. Built during the Grandes Juegos (Era del Confinamiento) and hosted all athletes and representatives from the world corners. Now stationed at the Feria del Milenio, in charge of one alcove of the Primer Pabellón's Espiral de las Eras: the station for Era del Confinamiento. Greets visitors there and tells them about the era.

experience: Encountered a time traveler from the Grandes Juegos era (year_esquema 2013-2015) who witnessed Khan Ice's entire development and confirmed the city's documented history.
Confirmed through first-hand testimony that the Hotel Kholi's presence from the Grandes Juegos era onward is an accurate historical record.
Met Farlis at his alcove during the Feria del Milenio, who understood immediately that monuments are living only when kept alive through story and presence.
Farlis drew a parallel between the Hotel Kholi and the Castillo de Görff in the Collective — both transformed spaces that remain themselves, proof that things can be different from what they were.
